Comment/Citation: Anything other than passive ownership of shares is prohibited for public officials. Officials must transfer the right of active ownership of the shares or parts of capital they own to another, unrelated person.

Total Ban: Law on Prevention of the Conflicts of Interests in the Exercise of Public Functions, No. 9367, adopted on Apr. 7, 2005, published in the Official Journal, No. 31, May 11, 2005, art. 22(2) (c), art. 24 (1), art. 38 (1) (c), (i), https://perma.cc/DD3T-A825.

Comment/Citation: Persons holding a public office are required to transfer their stocks and shares to trust management within one month after election.
